title: A5 a link nobody opened: the Share dialog says so and the dashboard shows a clear empty state (no errors)
B1 + B4 two different visitors in two browsers: two views, two visitors, within seconds
B2 the same visitor reloading is the same visit; A1 the Share dialog now shows the count and the last view
B5 the owner opening their own link is not counted (and the page still works); B9 Do Not Track sends and stores nothing
F3 analytics blocked (an ad-blocker) or failing: the presentation works normally and shows no error; nothing is counted
D1 + D2 what is stored: no IP, user-agent or raw id; the viewer page shows the privacy note; no cookie is set by tracking
C1 + C6 + C7 a visitor spends about 2 s on slide 1, 3 s on slide 2, goes back for 2 s, then closes the tab: times add up per slide and the last seconds are delivered
C6 five visitors each read one slide for ~3 s and close the tab at once: every one of those visits still has its time recorded (the last report survives the tab closing)
C4 time does not accrue while the tab is hidden (visibility event) and resumes afterwards
C2 + C3 three visitors stop at slide 1, 2 and 4: reach 100 / 66.7 / 33.3 / 33.3 %, one of three finished
E1 + E3 the dashboard shows exactly those numbers (views, visitors, finished, one row per slide with its reach)
E2 the daily chart adds up to the views; 7 / 30 / 90 days change the number of bars
E7 the open dashboard has no serious or critical accessibility violations (axe, WCAG A/AA) and every control has a name
C8 after slide 4 is deleted the table follows the deck (3 rows) and the time spent on it is kept as "removed slides"
E4 + E5 a phone visitor from LinkedIn in India and a direct computer visitor: devices, sources, countries and the recent list show them (no personal data)
B7 a password-protected link counts a visitor only after the right password (lock screen and wrong password do not count)
B10 the owner turns the link off while someone is viewing: tracking stops quietly, the viewer sees no error, and the presentation keeps working
D3 "Clear analytics" deletes every recorded visit of the deck at once
A3 a Starter owner sees the total number of views and an upgrade prompt, never the detail (the API does not send it)
E6 phone width (390 px): the dashboard fits, nothing scrolls sideways, tables stay readable
E8 5,000 recorded visits on one deck: the dashboard loads in a few seconds
